bull_case_summary: Eaton has organic sales and backlog growth plus higher realised FCF. Round two uses cash as a counterweight to segment margin compression without calling it a matched organic cash-margin measure, preserving conditional funded-execution upside.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts improved cash but retains the 80bp segment-margin decline, adjusted/GAAP EPS gap and unverified acquisition leverage. Guidance and extended technicals do not establish value at the snapshot premium.
key_points_of_agreement: Demand and absolute reported FCF improved.
Segment margin compressed and adjustments are material.
Organic growth and reported FCF are not a matched organic cash-margin comparison.
key_points_of_disagreement: How much improved cash counters margin and acquisition-funding pressure in a prospective purchase thesis.
unresolved_uncertainties: Profitable backlog conversion with stable margins.
Matched valuation and delivery of guidance without chasing extension.
